how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC.

Abre martes y sábado de 9:30am a 11:30am.
La despensa funciona solo el primer martes y el tercer sábado del mes.
Qué alimentos entrega y si hay requisitos no están indicados; pregunte por teléfono.

It is located at 75 Hill St, Staten Island, NY 10304.
It is open Tuesdays and Saturdays, 9:30am-11:30am.
The pantry operates only the 1st Tuesday and 3rd Saturday of the month.
What food is given and any requirements are not listed; ask by phone.
